Name: Rheall's Character Portrait Replacement Mod (for v1.5)
Author: rheall
Description:
Hello! This is my first ever mod for Stardew Valley, or on Nexus, so please be kind!

This mod replaces the character portraits with new ones drawn by yours truly. I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13]my favourite portrait overhaul mod by Kamirose[/url] (You can grab a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7745]newer version here[/url]), and some of my portraits are[i] very[/i] heavily inspired; their mod hasn't been updated since 2016, so I wanted to refresh it, add on to it, and give it my own spin. ^^ So many thanks to Kamirose for the inspiration, and for making my game so beautiful all these years!

Included are new portraits for all bachelors/bachelorettes (including changing Maru and her sprite to wear scrubs instead of the nurse uniform), all townies (folks that live in the Valley), plus Marlon, Morris and Sandy. See the complete list below. Not included are NPCs such as the Governor, Krobus, Gil, Mr. Qi, etc. I haven't changed character sprites, except for Maru's clinic uniform. The portraits should be all updated and good to go for SDV version 1.5 (though please let me know if you notice any issues!).

As I said above, this is my first ever mod for Stardew Valley or Nexus, so please forgive any hiccoughs. I tried to test and everything looked fine, but there might have been something I've missed. If you notice any mistakes or errors please let me know and I'll do what I can to remedy them!

[size=5]Install Instructions:
[/size][list=1]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod's .zip file and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/list]
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are REQUIRED for my portrait overhaul to work.
